title: Parrish Describes Pyle
content: In his reply to a young art student, Maxfield Parrish said: "I  do wish you could study under Howard Pyle: indeed you would enjoy it. I did myself for two years. He is so full enthusiasm there is plenty to spare and you get a lot that is left over. He does everything the same way: he goes in bathing, walks, plays games as if he were saving his household goods from a fire."Thanks, Steve!
